Zutu Typeface: Vintage Condensed Elegance
For graphic designers searching for a typeface with distinct flair, Zutu offers a reverse contrast slab-serif style that merges classic. appeal with modern design.  With its abundant open type features and an array of special characters, Zutu stands out in single styles and offers considerable personality.
